name: Sacrifice Body ~Kodai Meikyuu ni Fuujirareta Kindan no Nikutai Kaizou Hijutsu~
original_name: サクリファイスボディー～古代迷宮に封じられた禁断の肉体改造秘術～
source:
It was known as The Grave, an ancient labyrinth in which a 
forbidden art was sealed. Seeking treasure and fame many adventurers entered, never to return.
What happened to them?

Long thought defeated, a trio of heroines have been collected by a mysterious figure called the Grave Keeper in a stony prison deep inside labyrinth:
Sharqua the female Knight of Prauha Kingdom, Birgitta the Believer of Sophia, and Catelina "Catcha" the Summoner...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE157643.html]DLsite English[/url]]
